gloss: to joke around; to clown; to act silly

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: おどけていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to joke around; to clown; to act silly
definitions.explanation: To behave in a playful, comical way to amuse others. Often involves exaggerated gestures or expressions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧おどけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
おどけた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{笑|わら}わせた→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: He made the children laugh with a silly face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}く→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦わざと→わざと：03791_wazato⟧おどけて⟦{見|み}せた→見せる：01988_miseru⟧。
examples.english: The atmosphere got heavy, so she deliberately acted silly to lighten the mood.

notes:
おどける is an intransitive ichidan verb.

ASPECT (ている):
おどけて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ describes someone who is currently acting silly or who characteristically clowns around.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おどけた⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a comical face
- おどけた⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧: a playful tone
- おどけて⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧: to act silly (on purpose)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦ふざける→ふざける：09309_fuzakeru⟧ is broader, covering joking, messing around, and sometimes misbehaving. おどける focuses more on comical, clownish behavior intended to amuse.
